missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Лестница' is a feminine noun in the nominative as the subject. 'Эта' points at a specific one, and 'крутая' is the agreeing feminine adjective. A simple description.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Лестницу' is the accusative direct object of 'моют', taking the feminine -у ending. 'Рабочие' is the nominative plural subject. A straightforward action sentence.
Strategic focus: Genitive after 'у'. 'Лестницы' is the genitive form of 'лестница' after 'у', meaning by the staircase. 'Ведро' is the nominative subject. A useful spatial pattern.
Strategic focus: Dative after 'к'. 'Лестнице' is the dative form of 'лестница' after 'к', marking the goal of motion. 'Коридор' is the nominative subject. Useful for describing layouts.
Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'Лестнице' is the prepositional form of 'лестница' after 'на', locating the cat on the staircase. 'Кошка' is the nominative subject. A core location pattern.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after 'под'. 'Лестницей' is the instrumental form of 'лестница' after 'под', locating things under the staircase. 'Вещи' is the nominative plural subject.
Strategic focus: Dative after 'по'. 'Лестнице' is the dative form of 'лестница' after 'по', meaning movement along the stairs. 'Бабушка' is the nominative subject and 'медленно' the manner adverb.
Strategic focus: Nominative-like form after 'две'. 'Лестницы' follows 'две' in the genitive singular form used after two. 'Широкие' agrees in the plural. 'В доме' uses the prepositional 'доме'.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Лестницы' is the nominative plural of 'лестница', the subject. 'Все' quantifies it and 'старые' is the agreeing plural adjective. A simple plural statement.
Strategic focus: Instrumental plural after 'между'. 'Лестницами' is the instrumental plural of 'лестница' after 'между', meaning between the staircases. 'Лифт' is the nominative subject.
